## The problem

Workforce planning can treat a change of sector as equivalent to a change of occupation, obscuring differences in skills, access and transition burdens.

## What this work asks

Which requirements distinguish same-occupation sector changes from transitions between occupations in low-carbon workforce planning?

- Which requirements distinguish sector changes from transitions between occupations?
- How can occupational relatedness and transition requirements be calibrated from public evidence?

## How the work investigates it

The research line develops transparent methods based on public occupational evidence to examine relatedness and calibrate possible transition requirements.

## What better understanding could make possible

The work could help workforce researchers and practitioners identify which occupational changes create consequential requirements for workers and places.

## Evidence status and boundaries

**Evidence status.** Owner-approved research-line description; the methodology is in development.

**Claim boundaries.** The work does not predict individual employment outcomes or presume that all green employment is accessible or good work.
